result.keywords: This study examines a fictional coastal performance installation that pairs wind-driven glass instruments with reflected light patterns to create ambient recital spaces in public gardens. The work focuses on acoustic design, tactile wayfinding, and seasonal audience circulation rather than technical robotics, networking, or biomedical sensing. Methods include architectural mockups, material resonance testing, and small-scale visitor observation in a museum atrium setting.
result.title: Lantern Orchard for Tideglass Recitals.
